objective: Separate Ascalon synthetic curriculum from verified operational training exports, require independently attested provenance for operational admission, make family splits deterministic, and compute honest dataset quality/manifests.

rulesConsidered: Unverified, synthetic, or partial trajectories are not operational Ascalon ground truth.
A model proposal is not authorization; Guardian, lease/fencing, runtime, and F07 authority remain external.
Training admission requires evidence-backed provenance and Claim <= Evidence.
Train/validation/test partitions must not leak mission or scenario families.

notes: The change adds no credentials, model weights, production execution privileges, or new runtime authority.
Operational export now requires an upstream evidence-admission manifest; tests exercise rejection when the independent receipt is absent.

changes: Introduced separate VERIFIED_OPERATIONAL and SYNTHETIC_CURRICULUM exporter lanes.
Required verified receipt, human-review, or deterministic-teacher attestations for operational admission.
Marked historical GoldenTrajectoryBuilder records as SIMULATION_PSEUDO fixtures rather than production ground truth.
Moved generated synthetic curriculum shards and manifest into training/ascalon/data/curriculum/.
Replaced positional split assignment with stable SHA-256 mission-family hashing and explicit target-band semantics.
Replaced hardcoded success metrics with validator-derived quality metrics and an explicit NOT_EVALUATED replay status.
Added tests for lane isolation, independent receipt admission, deterministic reruns, and family split isolation.
Documented the dataset-lane contract and remaining production-admission requirements.
Changed the placeholder replay helper to return NOT_EXECUTED until an independent replay adapter exists; updated the readiness test to reject echo-based replay claims.
verificationPlan: Run the dedicated Ascalon training-readiness Vitest suite.
Run FactoryOS typecheck and repository-required checks.
Execute generate_datasets.ts and inspect curriculum lane, family splits, provenance counts, and computed metrics.
Verify synthetic records cannot enter VERIFIED_OPERATIONAL exports.
Verify VERIFIED_OUTCOME is rejected unless the referenced receipt is present in an independently produced evidence manifest.
Keep model-weight training and Ascalon/AER production promotion blocked.
Verify no Ascalon test treats echoing a recorded decision as deterministic replay evidence.

localExecution.note: No repository runtime/test environment was available through the GitHub file interface.

notes: The evidence-manifest sets are only trustworthy when produced by an independent upstream resolver. They must not be assembled from the trajectory's own evidence IDs.
The current Ascalon replay helper does not independently re-execute the recorded decision; the quality report now states NOT_EVALUATED rather than reporting a fabricated 100% replay rate.
The dataset split is deterministic by family. Exact 70/15/15 row counts are not promised for small or skewed sets.
No model weights were modified and no training job was dispatched.
No Guardian, Slayer, Healer, lease/fencing, F07, release, or production execution authority was changed.
The old replay helper returned the recorded decision as its own replay result without re-execution; the branch now fails closed and reports replay as not executed.
